notes: Nill Download Manager 1.9.2 — the main window is rebuilt in Internet Download Manager's classic layout (toolbar, categories tree and columns) with a polished one-colour finish, and the browser flyout is now a full IDM-style download dialog: the video thumbnail and per-quality file sizes are back, with labelled Status, File size, Downloaded, Transfer rate and Time left rows, an expandable connections detail view, a Resume capability line, and a working per-file Speed Limiter tab. Downloads also start faster (stream resolution is cached and warmed ahead of the click), a file deleted from the list no longer returns after a restart (the app now runs as a single instance), every file carries a Last Try Date, and a resumed download shows live progress again. Every change was verified in live use and a full audit of the app and extension.
